jp: \t\t異世界の女神が作り出したとされる絶器。それは光輝にして守護の剣。世界を越えて空から舞い降り、闇をはらうとされる黄金の翼。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t異世界の女神が作り出したとされる絶器。それは光輝にして守護の剣。世界を越えて空から舞い降り、闇をはらうとされる黄金の翼。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Exquisite weapons said to have been created by a goddess from another world. It is a sword of light and protection. These golden wings are said to transcend the world, descend from the sky, and repel darkness. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Exquisite weapons said to have been created by a goddess from another world. It is a sword of light and protection. These golden wings are said to transcend the world, descend from the sky, and repel darkness. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Uno zekki che dicono creato da una dea di un altro mondo. È la spada dello splendore e della custodia. Ali d'oro che, dicono, scendono dal cielo attraversando i mondi e spazzano via le tenebre. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t元は戦闘用義手だったものを、付け替えが容易な装備として発展させた。神経接続せずに電気信号を服の上から読み取るため、状況によっては思い通りに動かないこともある。マニピュレーターが頑丈に作られており、ギア比を変えることで強烈な攻撃も繰り出せる。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t元は戦闘用義手だったものを、付け替えが容易な装備として発展させた。神経接続せずに電気信号を服の上から読み取るため、状況によっては思い通りに動かないこともある。マニピュレーターが頑丈に作られており、ギア比を変えることで強烈な攻撃も繰り出せる。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Originally a prosthetic hand designed for combat, it has been developed into an easily replaceable piece of equipment. Electrical signals are read from the clothing without any neural connection, so depending on the situation, it may not work as desired. The manipulators are made to be sturdy, and by changing the gear ratio, powerful attacks can be unleashed. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Originally a prosthetic hand designed for combat, it has been developed into an easily replaceable piece of equipment. Electrical signals are read from the clothing without any neural connection, so depending on the situation, it may not work as desired. The manipulators are made to be sturdy, and by changing the gear ratio, powerful attacks can be unleashed. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Nasceva come protesi da combattimento, e da lì è stato sviluppato in un equipaggiamento che si cambia con facilità. Siccome legge i segnali elettrici da sopra i vestiti, senza collegarsi ai nervi, a seconda dei casi può non muoversi come si vorrebbe. I manipolatori sono costruiti robusti, e cambiando il rapporto degli ingranaggi si arriva a sferrare colpi violentissimi. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\tイェルス軍が火炎竜の翼を元に開発した飛行・推進ユニット。頑丈で、防御に使えないこともない。兵士の個人装備として開発されたが脚部装着型飛行ユニットにコンペで敗れ、採用は見送られた。しかしその飛行能力は確かであったため、後に空戦兵器の部品として転用されている。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tイェルス軍が火炎竜の翼を元に開発した飛行・推進ユニット。頑丈で、防御に使えないこともない。兵士の個人装備として開発されたが脚部装着型飛行ユニットにコンペで敗れ、採用は見送られた。しかしその飛行能力は確かであったため、後に空戦兵器の部品として転用されている。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Flight and propulsion unit developed by the Yerles military based on the wings of a flaming dragon. It is sturdy and can be used for defense. It was developed as personal equipment for soldiers, but lost in a competition to a leg-mounted flying unit and was not adopted. However, its flight capability was so strong that it was later used as a component in air combat weapons. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Flight and propulsion unit developed by the Yerles military based on the wings of a flaming dragon. It is sturdy and can be used for defense. It was developed as personal equipment for soldiers, but lost in a competition to a leg-mounted flying unit and was not adopted. However, its flight capability was so strong that it was later used as a component in air combat weapons. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un'unità di volo e propulsione che l'esercito di Yerles ha sviluppato partendo dalle ali di un drago di fuoco. È robusta, e a difendersi non è che non serva. La svilupparono come equipaggiamento personale del soldato, ma in gara perse contro un'unità di volo da montare sulle gambe e non fu adottata. La capacità di volo però era solida, e più tardi l'hanno riutilizzata come pezzo per le armi da combattimento aereo. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\tかつての英雄が身に着けていたマント。ボロボロのヨレヨレであるため、幸薄そうな者が着ると悪い意味でサマになってしまう。渋い人なら着こなせるかもしれないが。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tかつての英雄が身に着けていたマント。ボロボロのヨレヨレであるため、幸薄そうな者が着ると悪い意味でサマになってしまう。渋い人なら着こなせるかもしれないが。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: A cloak worn by heroes in the past. Because it is tattered and shabby, it looks bad when worn by someone who seems to be less fortunate. A person who is austere may be able to wear it, though. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "A cloak worn by heroes in the past. Because it is tattered and shabby, it looks bad when worn by someone who seems to be less fortunate. A person who is austere may be able to wear it, though. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Il mantello che portava un eroe di un tempo. È tutto strappato e sformato, e addosso a chi ha già l'aria sfortunata sta bene nel senso peggiore. Uno con un certo stile asciutto, magari, riuscirebbe a portarlo. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t異形の森から巻き起こる忌むべき風を防ぐという外套。あくまでも風による変異を防ぐ為の物なので、日常的な変異や雨風はしのげないだろう。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t異形の森から巻き起こる忌むべき風を防ぐという外套。あくまでも風による変異を防ぐ為の物なので、日常的な変異や雨風はしのげないだろう。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: This cloak is designed to protect against the abominable winds that arise from the Vindale Forest. It is designed to prevent etherwind-induced mutation, so it will not be able to withstand everyday mutation or rain and wind. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "This cloak is designed to protect against the abominable winds that arise from the Vindale Forest. It is designed to prevent etherwind-induced mutation, so it will not be able to withstand everyday mutation or rain and wind. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un mantello che, dicono, para il vento maledetto che si leva dalla Foresta Eretica. Serve unicamente a fermare le mutazioni portate da quel vento, e contro le mutazioni di tutti i giorni, o contro la pioggia e il vento, non riparerà. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\tコウモリの羽を模した装具。背中の攻撃を防ぐことができるが、あくまでも外見を彩る為に作られている。尚、微小ながら宙に浮くといった効果も持つ。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tコウモリの羽を模した装具。背中の攻撃を防ぐことができるが、あくまでも外見を彩る為に作られている。尚、微小ながら宙に浮くといった効果も持つ。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: Ornaments that resemble the wings of a bat. It can prevent attacks on the back, but it is made only to decorate the appearance of the wearer. It allows floating in the air, albeit only slightly. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "Ornaments that resemble the wings of a bat. It can prevent attacks on the back, but it is made only to decorate the appearance of the wearer. It allows floating in the air, albeit only slightly. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Un oggetto da indossare, fatto a somiglianza delle ali di un pipistrello. Para i colpi che arrivano alla schiena, ma è costruito unicamente per far bella figura. Ha anche, per quanto minimo, l'effetto di sollevare un po' da terra. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\t体に巻きつけるゆったりとした布生地。幾多の素材を織り込むことで布自体の強度を増している。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t体に巻きつけるゆったりとした布生地。幾多の素材を織り込むことで布自体の強度を増している。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: A loose-fitting fabric that wraps around the body. The strength of the cloth itself is increased by weaving in a number of materials. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "A loose-fitting fabric that wraps around the body. The strength of the cloth itself is increased by weaving in a number of materials. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Un tessuto ampio da avvolgersi attorno al corpo. Intrecciandoci dentro materiali di ogni sorta, la stoffa stessa ne esce più resistente. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\t素材を織り込んだ布の裏に固い金属を張り付けた外套。身に纏うことで幾らかの攻撃を防ぐことができる。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t素材を織り込んだ布の裏に固い金属を張り付けた外套。身に纏うことで幾らかの攻撃を防ぐことができる。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: A cloak of hard metal attached to the back of a cloth made of interwoven materials. Wearing this cloak can protect the wearer from some attacks. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "A cloak of hard metal attached to the back of a cloth made of interwoven materials. Wearing this cloak can protect the wearer from some attacks. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Un mantello con del metallo duro applicato dietro a una stoffa in cui sono intrecciati dei materiali. Addosso, para una parte dei colpi. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\t鎧の上から羽織る薄い布生地。幾多の素材を織り込むことで布自体の強度を増している。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t鎧の上から羽織る薄い布生地。幾多の素材を織り込むことで布自体の強度を増している。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: A thin cloth fabric worn over armor. The strength of the cloth itself is increased by weaving in a number of materials. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "A thin cloth fabric worn over armor. The strength of the cloth itself is increased by weaving in a number of materials. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Un tessuto sottile da buttarsi sulle spalle sopra l'armatura. Intrecciandoci dentro materiali di ogni sorta, la stoffa stessa ne esce più resistente. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~
